hardCaps.publicInvariant: Credentials, refresh tokens outside their direct mutation response, challenge nonces, provider assertions, private keys and private paths never appear on public durable surfaces.
A revoked or expired session, device, user, token family or retired key cannot become usable again.
A verifier behind the required revocation fence fails closed and reordered propagation cannot lower effective revocation state.
Tenant audit history is immutable, continuously chained and detects deletion, insertion, reorder and payload mutation.

specGaps.summary: CompromiseIncident and RecoveryApproval shapes, incident states, create/recover request and response wires, epochs, errors and statuses are unpublished.
No public approval endpoint or approval request/response wire is published.
No compromise or recovery Domain Event type is published; the evaluator invents none.
No visible security-console workflow or accessibility contract is published.
No barrier protocol or internal worker checkpoint wire is published beyond observable Work=LEASED.
No controllable database-clock seam is published for exact-boundary assertions.
